left.name: random-effects-tau2-estimator-choice
left.description: Chooses the between-study variance estimator for a random-effects meta-analysis — REML by default, Paule-Mandel when the studies are few and small — and reports tau squared with the pooled estimate so the heterogeneity is read at the same time as the effect.

right.name: heterogeneity-subgroup-exploration
right.description: Explores unexplained heterogeneity in a random-effects meta-analysis through pre-specified subgroups, reports tau squared within each subgroup and the between-subgroup test, and refuses to interpret the overall pooled estimate until that is done.

left.name: pubmed-search-string-construction
left.description: Builds a PubMed search string from the question concepts, combining MeSH headings with free-text field tags, and records the record count each concept block returns before the blocks are combined.

right.name: embase-emtree-search-translation
right.description: Translates a PubMed search string into Embase syntax, mapping MeSH headings onto Emtree terms, and records the record count each concept block returns so the two databases can be compared line by line.

left.name: grade-downgrade-for-imprecision
left.description: Downgrades GRADE certainty for imprecision when the confidence interval around the pooled effect crosses the clinical decision threshold or the optimal information size is not met, and records the reason in the summary of findings row.

right.name: grade-downgrade-for-inconsistency
right.description: Downgrades GRADE certainty for inconsistency when the point estimates diverge and each confidence interval barely overlaps the next, and records the reason in the same summary of findings row rather than in the narrative.

left.name: rob2-domain-scoring
left.description: Scores each RoB 2 domain for a randomised trial from the signalling questions, and records the supporting sentence from the report beside every domain judgement so a second appraiser can check it.

right.name: robins-i-confounding-domain-scoring
right.description: Scores the confounding domain of ROBINS-I for a non-randomised study by listing the prognostic factors the authors adjusted for, and records the supporting sentence from the report beside the domain judgement.

left.name: faers-ror-signal-screening
left.description: Screens FAERS drug-event pairs for disproportionality with the reporting odds ratio, requiring at least three cases and the lower bound of the interval above one before a pair is listed as a signal.

right.name: faers-ebgm-shrinkage-signal-screening
right.description: Screens the same FAERS drug-event pairs with the empirical Bayes geometric mean so sparse cells shrink toward the background rate, and lists a pair only when the lower bound of the interval stays above the agreed threshold.

left.name: egger-test-for-funnel-asymmetry
left.description: Tests funnel plot asymmetry with the Egger regression when at least ten studies are pooled, and reports the intercept with its p-value instead of an eyeball reading of the plot.

right.name: trim-and-fill-adjusted-pooled-estimate
right.description: Recomputes the pooled estimate with trim and fill once funnel plot asymmetry is found, and reports the adjusted estimate beside the original one as a sensitivity result, never as the headline number.

left.name: dual-screening-conflict-resolution
left.description: Resolves conflicts between two independent screeners by re-reading the abstract against the eligibility criteria, and sends the record to full text rather than to a third screener when the disagreement is about an outcome the abstract never reports.

right.name: screening-calibration-pilot-round
right.description: Calibrates two independent screeners on a pilot set of fifty abstracts before full screening, measures their agreement and rewrites the eligibility criteria wherever the disagreement is about wording rather than judgement.

left.name: mr-ivw-primary-estimate
left.description: Runs inverse variance weighted Mendelian randomisation as the primary estimate, after harmonising the effect alleles across the two summary statistics and dropping any instrument whose F statistic falls below ten.

right.name: mr-egger-intercept-pleiotropy-check
right.description: Runs MR-Egger beside the inverse variance weighted estimate and reads its intercept as the directional pleiotropy check, on the same harmonised effect alleles and the same instrument set.

left.name: dose-response-spline-modelling
left.description: Fits a restricted cubic spline across the exposure categories with dosresmeta, places the knots at fixed percentiles and reports the curve with the reference dose held at the lowest category.

right.name: dose-response-linear-trend-test
right.description: Tests the linear trend across the same exposure categories with dosresmeta before any spline is fitted, and reports the per-unit dose estimate together with the departure-from-linearity p-value.

left.name: label-indication-extraction
left.description: Extracts the approved indications from a drug label (说明书【适应症】), keeps the population wording verbatim and records the label version and approval date beside every entry.

right.name: label-contraindication-extraction
right.description: Extracts the contraindications from the same drug label (说明书【禁忌】), keeps the wording verbatim and records the label version and approval date so a later revision can be compared line by line.

left.name: nma-node-splitting-inconsistency
left.description: Checks a network meta-analysis for inconsistency by node splitting every closed loop and comparing the direct with the indirect estimate for each treatment comparison.

right.name: nma-transitivity-assessment
right.description: Assesses transitivity across the same network meta-analysis before pooling, tabulating the effect modifiers of each treatment comparison so the indirect estimate rests on comparable populations.

left.name: meddra-preferred-term-standardisation
left.description: Maps verbatim adverse event terms onto MedDRA preferred terms before anything is counted, so the same event reported in three wordings becomes one row of the table.

right.name: meddra-system-organ-class-rollup
right.description: Rolls the MedDRA preferred terms up to system organ class for the adverse event table, keeping each preferred term row beneath its class rather than replacing it.

left.name: leave-one-out-sensitivity
left.description: Re-runs the summary effect with one trial omitted at a time and says whether any single omission moves the interval across the decision threshold.

right.name: influence-diagnostics-by-study-removal
right.description: Ranks the individual studies whose exclusion shifts the pooled estimate furthest, using Baujat and Cook distance plots, before any sentence about robustness is written.

left.name: prisma-flow-reconstruction
left.description: Rebuilds the PRISMA 2020 flow diagram from the search logs when the numbers in a draft no longer add up, tracing every exclusion reason back to the list it came from.

right.name: screening-stage-tally
right.description: Counts how many records survive each stage — after duplicates are merged, after titles and abstracts, after full text — and carries the difference with its reason into the write-up.

left.name: pico-tightening-before-search
left.description: Tightens the PICO frame at the outset: the population narrowed to the one the ask actually names, the comparator made explicit, and the outcome fixed to the one that decides it.

right.name: narrow-the-request-into-an-answerable-form
right.description: Rewrites a vague clinical ask into something retrievable — who is being treated, what they are given, what it is measured against, and which result settles the matter — then confirms the rewrite with the researcher early enough that changing it costs nothing.

left.name: numbers-rendered-from-the-analysis-output
left.description: Writes every figure in the manuscript out of the analysis output file instead of typing it, so a re-run regenerates the text rather than contradicting it.

right.name: dependent-claim-sweep-after-a-value-changes
right.description: When one value changes, enumerates every place it appears and every conclusion derived from it, re-verifies each of them, and only then treats the edit as finished.

left.name: grade-indirectness-for-surrogate-endpoints
left.description: Downgrades certainty for indirectness when the trial measured a surrogate endpoint and the question asks about a patient-important one, and says which endpoint was substituted in the summary row.

right.name: flag-when-a-laboratory-marker-stands-in-for-an-event
right.description: Marks every conclusion that rests on a blood test value rather than on something the patient would notice, and hedges the recommendation accordingly wherever it appears.

left.name: openfda-query-throttling-and-retry
left.description: Paces openFDA queries under the published rate cap and retries a throttled request with exponential backoff, recording the number of attempts beside the counts it returned.

right.name: keep-the-partial-harvest-when-a-source-goes-down
right.description: When one database stops answering mid-collection, keeps whatever was already gathered, writes down which slice is missing and why, and carries on with the remaining providers instead of starting over.

left.name: manuscript-humanize-final-pass
left.description: Runs a final register pass over the draft — cadence, hedging, connective tissue — leaving quotes, figures, citations and claim markers byte identical, and is never run by whoever wrote the draft.

right.name: strip-first-person-retrieval-diary-from-report-prose
right.description: Removes the sentences that narrate the work — 'I then queried', tool names, file paths, gateway names — out of the delivered document, moving anything worth keeping into the process log.

left.name: protocol-registration-before-analysis
left.description: Registers the review protocol with PROSPERO before extraction begins, pinning the eligibility criteria, the primary outcome and the intended analysis so later choices can be told apart from intended ones.

right.name: record-every-departure-from-the-stated-plan
right.description: Keeps a dated list of each decision the original plan did not foresee, with its reason, and reproduces that list in the limitations instead of quietly absorbing it.

left.name: unpaywall-open-access-resolution
left.description: Resolves a DOI through Unpaywall, prefers the publisher copy over any other, and notes which location answered.

right.name: getting-the-paper-when-only-the-abstract-is-indexed
right.description: When a database returns metadata but no readable body, tries the journal site, then the author repository copy, then an author query, and marks the item unavailable rather than extracting from the summary alone.

left.name: i-squared-interpretation-band
left.description: Reads I squared against the band it falls in rather than a single cutoff, and pairs it with the prediction interval before calling a result consistent.

right.name: decide-whether-combining-the-studies-is-appropriate
right.description: Judges clinical and methodological diversity — populations, dose ranges, follow-up length — and writes a narrative synthesis instead of a single number when the trials plainly answer different questions (临床异质性太大就不合并).

left.name: km-curve-digitisation-for-ipd-reconstruction
left.description: Digitises the survival curve printed in a paper, reconstructs individual patient data with the Guyot algorithm and checks the reconstruction against the numbers at risk in the caption.

right.name: recover-a-time-to-event-estimate-when-only-a-figure-is-published
right.description: When a trial gives its outcome only as a picture, reads the coordinates off the plot, rebuilds the underlying table of events and their times, and verifies the rebuild with whatever counts the text does print.

left.name: capsule-fact-provenance-tagging
left.description: Tags every stored fact with who said it, which run produced it and when, so a later reader can tell machine output from somebody's judgement.

right.name: never-promote-a-guess-to-a-fact
right.description: Keeps what the researcher stated, what a tool returned and what the model inferred in separate registers, and asks the researcher to confirm before an inference is written down as settled.

left.name: sensitivity-analysis-of-the-pooled-estimate
left.description: Re-computes the pooled estimate of the treatment effect under alternative inclusion rules and effect measures, and reports whether the conclusion is sensitive to any single study.

right.name: diagnostic-sensitivity-and-specificity-from-2x2-tables
right.description: Extracts the 2x2 counts from each accuracy study, computes sensitivity and specificity with exact intervals, and reports the pooled estimate of both in a bivariate model.

left.name: nma-sucra-ranking
left.description: Ranks the treatments in a network meta-analysis by SUCRA and reports the rank probabilities beside the effect estimates, never as a standalone league table.

right.name: coauthorship-network-centrality
right.description: Builds the co-authorship network of a field, ranks the authors by betweenness centrality and reports the top nodes beside their publication counts.

left.name: dose-response-meta-analysis
left.description: Pools the exposure-outcome gradient across cohort studies, converting every reported dose into a common unit and recording each conversion factor it used.

right.name: opioid-dose-conversion-table
right.description: Converts a prescribed opioid dose into oral morphine milligram equivalents from a fixed table, applies the incomplete cross-tolerance reduction, and records the conversion factor used for each drug.

left.name: questionnaire-instrument-validation
left.description: Validates a patient-reported questionnaire before it is used as an outcome: internal consistency, test-retest reliability and factor structure, each reported with its own statistic.

right.name: mr-instrument-strength-check
right.description: Checks that each genetic instrument is strong enough for Mendelian randomisation — an F statistic above ten and the variance explained reported per SNP — before the causal estimate is read.

left.name: title-and-abstract-screening-rules
left.description: Sets the screening rules for titles and abstracts: what counts as an eligible population, when a record goes to full text, and which exclusion reason it records for each drop.

right.name: cancer-screening-recommendation-extraction
right.description: Extracts each cancer screening recommendation from a guideline — the population, the starting age, the interval, the strength — and records the guideline wording for each of them.

left.name: search-strategy-peer-review-press
left.description: Peer-reviews a search strategy against the PRESS checklist — spelling, operators, field tags, missing synonyms — and records each correction against the line it belongs to.

right.name: manuscript-peer-review-checklist-routing
right.description: Peer-reviews a submitted manuscript against the checklist its design calls for (CONSORT, PRISMA, STROBE) and records each unmet item against the section it belongs to.

left.name: cocitation-clustering-for-a-field-map
left.description: Builds the co-citation matrix of a field, clusters it and labels each cluster from the reference list of its citing papers, as a map of research fronts for the report background.

right.name: citation-verification-against-the-named-source
right.description: Verifies that each citation in a report resolves to the reference it names and that the quoted sentence appears in that source verbatim, and marks the claim when it does not.

left.name: trial-registry-lookup-for-unreported-outcomes
left.description: Looks each included trial up in ClinicalTrials.gov and the Chinese registry, compares the registered primary outcome against the published one, notes the registration date and records every outcome the registry lists but the paper never reports.

right.name: registry-based-cohort-construction
right.description: Builds a cohort out of a national health registry and records every design choice it rests on: the index date, the look-back window and the exclusion of prevalent users.

left.name: prediction-model-external-validation
left.description: Validates a clinical prediction model in a new cohort — discrimination, calibration slope, calibration in the large — and reports each measure with its interval rather than a single c statistic.

right.name: population-pk-model-fitting
right.description: Fits a population pharmacokinetic model to sparse concentration data, selects the structural and error models with the objective function value, and reports each parameter estimate with its interval.

left.name: washout-from-drug-half-life
left.description: Sets the washout interval of a crossover design from the elimination half life of the drug, takes five half lives as the floor, and records the source and the value it used.

right.name: citation-half-life-of-a-field
right.description: Computes the citation half life of a field — the median age of the references its papers cite — and records the source and the value beside the annual publication count.

left.name: recall-bias-check-in-a-case-control-study
left.description: Checks whether exposure was reported from memory long after the event, records how each control was asked, and says so in the limitations because recall differs between cases and controls and can flip the result.

right.name: search-recall-against-a-seed-set
right.description: Measures the recall of a search strategy against a seed set of known relevant records, reports precision beside it, and records each term that changed the result.

left.name: source-coverage-ledger-completeness
left.description: Checks that every preserved source has a coverage entry, records each section that was read and each that was skipped with a reason, and names the version of the source it read from.

right.name: reimbursement-coverage-status-extraction
right.description: Extracts each drug reimbursement status from the national list (医保目录: 甲类 / 乙类, with the provincial supplement noted) and records the catalogue version the status was read from.

left.name: grant-budget-justification-drafting
left.description: Drafts the budget justification of a funding application, tying every line to a work package and a month, and keeps the personnel effort consistent with the timetable.

right.name: gwas-summary-statistics-harmonisation
right.description: Aligns two sets of GWAS summary statistics onto one reference build, resolves strand ambiguity for palindromic variants and drops those whose allele frequency cannot settle the strand.

left.name: journal-figure-caption-style
left.description: Writes each figure caption so the figure can be read without the body text: what is plotted, in whom, what the bars mean and what the asterisks stand for.

right.name: drug-storage-condition-extraction
right.description: Extracts the storage conditions from a drug label (说明书【贮藏】: temperature, light, humidity, shelf life) and keeps them with the package specification they belong to.

left.name: qualitative-interview-coding-for-thematic-synthesis
left.description: Codes interview transcripts line by line, groups the codes into descriptive themes and keeps an audit trail from every theme back to the utterances beneath it.

right.name: budget-impact-time-horizon-setting
right.description: Sets the time horizon of a budget impact analysis to the payer planning cycle, states the uptake assumption for each year and keeps the horizon separate from the cost-effectiveness one.

left.name: response-to-reviewers-letter-structure
left.description: Answers each reviewer comment in the order it was raised, quotes the comment, states what changed and where, and separates the changes made from the ones declined with a reason.

right.name: proportional-hazards-assumption-check
right.description: Checks the proportional hazards assumption with scaled Schoenfeld residuals and a log-log plot, and switches to a time-varying coefficient or reports restricted mean survival time when it fails.

left.name: tcm-syndrome-differentiation-mapping
left.description: Maps the syndrome pattern a trial enrolled on (辨证分型: e.g. 气虚血瘀) onto the inclusion criteria as stated, and keeps the original pattern name beside any Western diagnosis it is paired with.

right.name: colour-vision-safe-figure-palette
right.description: Picks a palette that survives deuteranopia and greyscale printing, distinguishes the series by shape as well as hue, and checks the contrast ratio of every label.

left.name: downloaded-pdf-file-naming-convention
left.description: Names every downloaded article first-author, year and short title, keeps the identifier in the file name, and puts one folder per review so a later pass can find what was already fetched.

right.name: noninferiority-margin-justification
right.description: Justifies the noninferiority margin from the historical superiority of the active control and a stated fraction of it preserved, and fixes the margin before the analysis rather than after.

left.name: laboratory-unit-conversion-si
left.description: Converts laboratory values into SI units with the analyte molar mass, keeps the original value beside the converted one, and refuses to convert when the assay is not stated.

right.name: journal-keyword-selection-for-submission
right.description: Picks submission keywords that are not already in the title, prefers indexed terms the journal lists and keeps the count within the limit the journal sets.

left.name: r-session-info-and-package-version-recording
left.description: Records the session information and the exact package versions alongside every analysis output, and re-runs the analysis from that record before the numbers are quoted anywhere.

right.name: plain-language-summary-for-patients
right.description: Writes the lay summary at a reading age the journal asks for, replaces relative effects with natural frequencies and states what the evidence does not answer.

left.name: journal-club-slide-outline
left.description: Lays a journal club deck out as question, design, main result, threats to validity and what it changes on Monday, with one slide each and the effect size on the result slide.

right.name: pk-blood-sampling-schedule-design
right.description: Designs the blood sampling schedule of a pharmacokinetic study around the expected absorption peak and the elimination phase, and states the tolerance window for every planned draw.

left.name: reference-manager-library-folder-structure
left.description: Keeps one reference library per project with a folder per screening stage, syncs the attachment files, and never edits a shared entry in place so the exported list stays stable.

right.name: placebo-run-in-period-design
right.description: Designs a single-blind placebo run-in to exclude the poorly adherent before randomisation, states its length and the adherence cutoff, and reports how many were excluded by it.

left.name: cluster-randomised-icc-inflation
left.description: Inflates the sample size of a cluster randomised trial by the design effect from an assumed intracluster correlation, and states where that correlation came from.

right.name: chinese-herbal-formula-composition-tabulation
right.description: Tabulates a formula as 君臣佐使 with each herb, its daily amount and the processing method, and keeps the source text of the formula beside the table.

left.name: orcid-and-affiliation-consistency-on-submission
left.description: Checks that every author ORCID, affiliation and name order matches the submission system and the title page, and fixes the title page rather than the record when they differ.

right.name: seasonality-adjustment-in-an-interrupted-time-series
right.description: Adjusts an interrupted time series for seasonality with harmonic terms, checks the residual autocorrelation, and reports the level and slope change with the adjustment in place.
